# RACI Chart Template

**Project Name:** [Insert Project Name]  
**Version:** 1.0  
**Last Updated:** [Date]  
**Owner:** [Project Manager Name]

## Purpose
This RACI chart clarifies roles and responsibilities for project activities. Use this to eliminate confusion about who does what and ensure accountability across the team.

## RACI Legend
- **R = Responsible:** Does the work to complete the task
- **A = Accountable:** Ultimately answerable for completion and has decision authority (only one A per task)
- **C = Consulted:** Provides input and expertise (two-way communication)
- **I = Informed:** Kept up-to-date on progress (one-way communication)

## RACI Matrix

| Activity / Deliverable | Project Manager | Product Manager | Developer | UX/UI Designer | Technical Writer | Security Lead | Support Engineer | Business Analyst | QA/Testing | Stakeholders |
|------------------------|----------------|-----------------|-----------|----------------|------------------|---------------|------------------|------------------|------------|--------------|
| **Initiation Phase** |
| Project One-pager | C | A | I | I | I | I | I | C | I | C |
| Stakeholder Alignment | A | R | I | I | I | I | I | C | I | C |
| Initial Risk Assessment | R | C | C | I | I | C | I | C | I | I |
| **Planning Phase** |
| Requirements Gathering | C | R | C | C | I | C | C | A | C | C |
| Backlog Creation | R | A | C | C | I | I | I | C | C | I |
| Sprint Planning | R | C | A | C | I | I | I | C | C | I |
| Test Plan | C | I | C | C | I | C | I | I | A | I |
| Design Specifications | C | C | I | A | I | I | I | I | I | I |
| Security Requirements | C | C | C | I | I | A | I | C | C | C |
| **Execution Phase** |
| Feature Implementation | C | I | A | C | I | C | I | I | C | I |
| Code Reviews | I | I | A/R | C | I | C | I | I | C | I |
| Design Review | C | C | C | A | I | I | I | I | I | I |
| Security Testing | C | I | C | I | I | A | I | I | R | I |
| Documentation Updates | I | I | C | C | A | I | C | I | I | I |
| **Release Phase** |
| Release Planning | A | C | C | I | I | C | C | I | C | C |
| Deployment Execution | C | I | R | I | I | C | I | I | A | I |
| Release Notes | C | A | C | I | R | C | I | I | C | C |

| Support Handoff | C | C | C | I | C | C | A | I | C | C |
| **Retrospective** |
| Retrospective Facilitation | A | C | R | R | R | R | R | R | R | I |
| Action Items Tracking | A | C | C | C | C | C | C | C | C | I |

## Customization Instructions
1. Add or remove columns based on your project's team composition
2. Add rows for project-specific activities or deliverables
3. Review and update this chart at project kickoff and whenever roles change
4. Store this chart in your project repository for easy reference
5. Link to this chart from your project README or charter

## Best Practices
- Keep only one "A" (Accountable) per row to ensure clear decision authority
- Avoid having too many "C" (Consulted) roles for any single activity—it can slow decisions
- Review the chart with the team to ensure everyone understands their responsibilities
- Update the chart if roles or responsibilities shift during the project
- Reference this chart when escalating issues or clarifying ownership

---

**Note:** This template should be copied and customized for each project. The sample assignments above are illustrative—adjust based on your team structure and project needs.
